newsitem.title: USA: Lee County, Fla., to sell $25.6 mln school COPs.
newsitem.headline: Lee County, Fla., to sell $25.6 mln school COPs.

text.p: Lee County, Fla., school board plans to sell $25.6 million of certificates of participation early next week, an official involved in the sale said Monday.
Smith Barney Inc is senior manager for the negotiated deal, which will have maturities out to 20 years.
Financial Security Assurance will insure the deal, the bond documents said.
The certificates will finance aquisition and construction of one new middle school and additions at three others.
